---
title: "Explore gradient boosting"
toc: false
page-layout: full
---

Gradient boosting also builds an ensemble **sequentially**, but it takes a
different route from AdaBoost. Here, we predict continuous NOx concentration
from AT, CDP, and TEY. The model starts with one constant NOx prediction. Each
new small **regression tree** then learns a continuous correction to the
current prediction. With squared-error loss, the quantity it learns from is
the ordinary residual $r_i = y_i - \hat{y}_i$.

::: {.callout-tip}
## What to watch

Every stage uses the same training observations—there is no bootstrap sample
and no observation-weight update. The new tree sees the current residuals:
positive values mean the model underpredicts NOx, and negative values mean it
overpredicts. Follow the tree's correction for one held-out observation, then
watch training and held-out MSE as stages are added.
:::

```{=html}
<div id="gradient-boosting-explorer" class="bagging-explorer gradient-boosting-explorer" aria-label="Interactive gradient boosting explorer">
  <div class="bagging-toolbar">
    <div class="clt-buttons" aria-label="Gradient-boosting stage controls">
      <button id="gradient-boosting-next-stage" type="button" class="regression-sampling-primary">Add next correction tree</button>
      <button id="gradient-boosting-run-all" type="button">Run all stages</button>
      <button id="gradient-boosting-reset" type="button">Reset</button>
    </div>
    <div class="bagging-progress" aria-live="polite">
      <span>Correction trees fitted:</span>
      <strong><output id="gradient-boosting-stage-count">1</output>/<span id="gradient-boosting-total-stage-count">60</span></strong>
    </div>
  </div>

  <section class="bagging-step gradient-boosting-baseline-step" aria-labelledby="gradient-boosting-baseline-heading">
    <div class="bagging-step-heading">
      <span class="bagging-step-number">1</span>
      <div>
        <h2 id="gradient-boosting-baseline-heading">Start with one constant model</h2>
        <p>Before any tree is fitted, every observation receives the average training NOx concentration.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="gradient-boosting-baseline-card" class="gradient-boosting-baseline-card" aria-label="Initial constant model"></div>
  </section>

  <section class="bagging-step gradient-boosting-tree-step" aria-labelledby="gradient-boosting-tree-heading">
    <div class="bagging-step-heading">
      <span class="bagging-step-number">2</span>
      <div>
        <h2 id="gradient-boosting-tree-heading">Fit a shallow regression tree to the residuals</h2>
```

For each training observation, $r_i = y_i - \hat{y}_i$. A positive residual
calls for a higher NOx prediction; a negative residual calls for a lower
prediction. The histogram uses one fixed residual scale across all stages, so
its spread shows how much error remains for the next tree to correct.

```{=html}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="gradient-boosting-tree-card" class="gradient-boosting-tree-card" aria-label="Current residuals and regression-tree NOx corrections"></div>
  </section>

  <section class="bagging-step" aria-labelledby="gradient-boosting-update-heading">
    <div class="bagging-step-heading">
      <span class="bagging-step-number">3</span>
      <div>
        <h2 id="gradient-boosting-update-heading">Apply the correction to one new observation</h2>
        <p>The tree uses only the observation's features to add a continuous adjustment to the current NOx prediction. Its measured NOx is shown afterward only for comparison.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="gradient-boosting-update-card" class="gradient-boosting-update-card" aria-label="Current NOx prediction update for one held-out observation"></div>
  </section>

  <section class="bagging-step" aria-labelledby="gradient-boosting-evaluation-heading">
    <div class="bagging-step-heading">
      <span class="bagging-step-number">4</span>
      <div>
        <h2 id="gradient-boosting-evaluation-heading">Evaluate the growing model</h2>
        <p>Each intermediate ensemble is evaluated against the same held-out observations. Training MSE shows fit to the training data; held-out MSE tells us whether the corrections generalize.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="gradient-boosting-charts">
      <figure class="gradient-boosting-figure">
        <figcaption>Mean squared error as correction trees are added</figcaption>
        <svg id="gradient-boosting-loss-chart" role="img" aria-label="Training and held-out mean squared error after each gradient-boosting stage"></svg>
      </figure>
      <figure class="gradient-boosting-figure">
        <figcaption>Held-out R<sup>2</sup> as correction trees are added</figcaption>
        <svg id="gradient-boosting-r2-chart" role="img" aria-label="Held-out R-squared after each gradient-boosting stage"></svg>
      </figure>
    </div>
  </section>
</div>

The residual histograms, fitted-tree rules, prediction corrections, and evaluation
metrics are precomputed from the gas-turbine data. The page reveals real fitted
trees; it does not train models in the browser.

<p style="margin-top: 1.5rem;"><a href="index.html">← Return to Tree-based models</a></p>

<script src="../assets/gradient-boosting-explorer.js"></script>
<script>
(() => {
  const root = document.getElementById("gradient-boosting-explorer");
  const explorer = window.MECE4520GradientBoostingExplorer;
  if (!root || !explorer) return;

  const stageCountOutput = root.querySelector("#gradient-boosting-stage-count");
  const totalStageCount = root.querySelector("#gradient-boosting-total-stage-count");
  const nextButton = root.querySelector("#gradient-boosting-next-stage");
  const runButton = root.querySelector("#gradient-boosting-run-all");
  const resetButton = root.querySelector("#gradient-boosting-reset");
  const baselineCard = root.querySelector("#gradient-boosting-baseline-card");
  const treeCard = root.querySelector("#gradient-boosting-tree-card");
  const updateCard = root.querySelector("#gradient-boosting-update-card");
  const lossChart = root.querySelector("#gradient-boosting-loss-chart");
  const r2Chart = root.querySelector("#gradient-boosting-r2-chart");
  if (!stageCountOutput || !totalStageCount || !nextButton || !runButton || !resetButton
      || !baselineCard || !treeCard || !updateCard || !lossChart || !r2Chart) return;

  const colors = {
    boost: "#2b7a78",
    train: "#457eaa",
    test: "#d77732",
    positive: "#287a51",
    negative: "#b64a4a",
    grid: "#d8e1e5",
    axis: "#5d6a72",
    text: "#34454d"
  };
  const nStages = explorer.metadata.nStages;
  let includedStages = 1;
  let animationFrame = null;
  let lastFrameTime = 0;
  let isRunning = false;

  totalStageCount.textContent = String(nStages);

  function activeRound() {
    return explorer.rounds[includedStages - 1];
  }

  function svgElement(name, attributes = {}) {
    const element = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", name);
    Object.entries(attributes).forEach(([key, value]) => element.setAttribute(key, value));
    return element;
  }

  function addText(svg, text, x, y, attributes = {}) {
    const element = svgElement("text", Object.assign({ x, y }, attributes));
    element.textContent = text;
    svg.append(element);
    return element;
  }

  function scale(value, domain, range) {
    return range[0] + ((value - domain[0]) / (domain[1] - domain[0])) * (range[1] - range[0]);
  }

  function makeMetric(label, value, note) {
    const metric = document.createElement("div");
    metric.className = "gradient-boosting-metric";
    const title = document.createElement("span");
    const number = document.createElement("strong");
    const description = document.createElement("small");
    title.textContent = label;
    number.textContent = value;
    description.textContent = note;
    metric.append(title, number, description);
    return metric;
  }

  function formatR2(value) {
    if (Math.abs(value) < 0.0005) return "≈ 0.000";
    return value.toFixed(3);
  }

  function makeFeatureTable() {
    const table = document.createElement("table");
    table.className = "bagging-feature-table";
    const head = document.createElement("thead");
    const headRow = document.createElement("tr");
    ["Feature", "Value"].forEach((label) => {
      const cell = document.createElement("th");
      cell.scope = "col";
      cell.textContent = label;
      headRow.append(cell);
    });
    head.append(headRow);
    const body = document.createElement("tbody");
    Object.entries(explorer.predictionObservation.features).forEach(([feature, value]) => {
      const row = document.createElement("tr");
      const featureCell = document.createElement("td");
      const valueCell = document.createElement("td");
      featureCell.textContent = feature;
      valueCell.textContent = Number(value).toFixed(2);
      row.append(featureCell, valueCell);
      body.append(row);
    });
    table.append(head, body);
    return table;
  }

  function renderBaseline() {
    baselineCard.replaceChildren();
    baselineCard.append(
      makeMetric(
        "Initial NOx prediction",
        explorer.baseline.prediction.toFixed(2) + " mg/m³",
        "the average NOx concentration in the training data"
      ),
      makeMetric(
        "Held-out MSE",
        explorer.baseline.testMse.toFixed(2),
        "before any correction tree is added"
      ),
      makeMetric(
        "Held-out R²",
        formatR2(explorer.baseline.testR2),
        "relative to the held-out mean baseline"
      )
    );
  }

  function renderTreeCard() {
    const round = activeRound();
    const residuals = document.createElement("div");
    residuals.className = "gradient-boosting-residuals";
    const residualTitle = document.createElement("strong");
    residualTitle.textContent = "Residual targets before Stage " + round.stage;
    const residualFormula = document.createElement("p");
    residualFormula.innerHTML = "<code>r = y − ŷ</code> is the target for this tree. Positive residuals need an upward correction; negative residuals need a downward correction.";
    const histogram = svgElement("svg", {
      class: "gradient-boosting-residual-histogram",
      role: "img"
    });
    drawResidualHistogram(histogram, round);
    const residualNote = document.createElement("small");
    residualNote.textContent = "The horizontal scale is fixed across stages: a tighter distribution means less remaining error.";
    residuals.append(residualTitle, residualFormula, histogram, residualNote);

    const tree = document.createElement("div");
    tree.className = "gradient-boosting-tree";
    const treeTitle = document.createElement("strong");
    treeTitle.textContent = "Stage " + round.stage + ": learned residual-correction tree";
    const rootRule = document.createElement("p");
    rootRule.innerHTML = "<strong>Root rule:</strong> " + round.root.feature + " ≤ " + round.root.threshold.toFixed(3)
      + ". Each leaf predicts the mean residual for its training samples.";
    const leaves = document.createElement("div");
    leaves.className = "gradient-boosting-leaves";
    round.leaves.forEach((leaf) => {
      const leafCard = document.createElement("div");
      const selected = leaf.rule === round.fixedObservation.leafRule;
      leafCard.className = "gradient-boosting-leaf" + (selected ? " gradient-boosting-leaf-selected" : "");
      const rule = document.createElement("span");
      const correction = document.createElement("strong");
      const count = document.createElement("small");
      rule.textContent = leaf.rule;
      correction.textContent = (leaf.correction >= 0 ? "+" : "")
        + leaf.correction.toFixed(2) + " mg/m³";
      count.textContent = leaf.nSamples.toLocaleString() + " training samples";
      leafCard.append(rule, correction, count);
      leaves.append(leafCard);
    });
    const note = document.createElement("small");
    note.textContent = "The highlighted leaf supplies the unshrunk tree output; the next step applies the learning rate.";
    tree.append(treeTitle, rootRule, leaves, note);

    treeCard.replaceChildren(residuals, tree);
  }

  function drawResidualHistogram(svg, round) {
    const width = 420;
    const height = 245;
    const padding = { top: 14, right: 14, bottom: 42, left: 48 };
    const histogram = explorer.metadata.residualHistogram;
    const edges = histogram.binEdges;
    const counts = round.residualHistogram;
    const xDomain = [edges[0], edges[edges.length - 1]];
    const yMaximum = Math.max(1, histogram.maxCount);
    const x = (value) => scale(value, xDomain, [padding.left, width - padding.right]);
    const y = (value) => scale(value, [0, yMaximum], [height - padding.bottom, padding.top]);

    svg.replaceChildren();
    svg.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 " + width + " " + height);
    svg.setAttribute("preserveAspectRatio", "xMidYMid meet");
    const title = svgElement("title", { id: "gradient-boosting-residual-histogram-title" });
    const description = svgElement("desc", { id: "gradient-boosting-residual-histogram-description" });
    title.textContent = "Training residual distribution before Stage " + round.stage;
    description.textContent = "Histogram of residuals with a fixed horizontal scale across all gradient-boosting stages.";
    svg.append(title, description);
    svg.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", title.id + " " + description.id);

    for (let index = 0; index <= 4; index += 1) {
      const count = (index / 4) * yMaximum;
      const yPosition = y(count);
      svg.append(svgElement("line", {
        x1: padding.left,
        y1: yPosition,
        x2: width - padding.right,
        y2: yPosition,
        class: "gradient-boosting-chart-grid"
      }));
      addText(svg, String(Math.round(count)), padding.left - 8, yPosition + 4, {
        class: "gradient-boosting-chart-tick",
        "text-anchor": "end"
      });
    }
    for (let index = 0; index <= 4; index += 1) {
      const value = xDomain[0] + (index / 4) * (xDomain[1] - xDomain[0]);
      const xPosition = x(value);
      svg.append(svgElement("line", {
        x1: xPosition,
        y1: padding.top,
        x2: xPosition,
        y2: height - padding.bottom,
        class: "gradient-boosting-chart-grid"
      }));
      addText(svg, value.toFixed(0), xPosition, height - padding.bottom + 18, {
        class: "gradient-boosting-chart-tick",
        "text-anchor": "middle"
      });
    }
    const zeroPosition = x(0);
    svg.append(svgElement("line", {
      x1: zeroPosition,
      y1: padding.top,
      x2: zeroPosition,
      y2: height - padding.bottom,
      class: "gradient-boosting-residual-zero-line"
    }));
    counts.forEach((count, index) => {
      const left = x(edges[index]);
      const right = x(edges[index + 1]);
      const center = (edges[index] + edges[index + 1]) / 2;
      const top = y(count);
      svg.append(svgElement("rect", {
        x: left + 1,
        y: top,
        width: Math.max(0, right - left - 2),
        height: height - padding.bottom - top,
        class: center < 0
          ? "gradient-boosting-residual-bar-negative"
          : "gradient-boosting-residual-bar-positive"
      }));
    });
    svg.append(
      svgElement("line", { x1: padding.left, y1: padding.top, x2: padding.left, y2: height - padding.bottom, class: "gradient-boosting-chart-axis" }),
      svgElement("line", { x1: padding.left, y1: height - padding.bottom, x2: width - padding.right, y2: height - padding.bottom, class: "gradient-boosting-chart-axis" })
    );
    addChartLabel(svg, "Residual, r = y − ŷ (mg/m³)", (padding.left + width - padding.right) / 2, height - 6);
    addText(svg, "Training samples", 14, height / 2, {
      class: "gradient-boosting-chart-axis-title",
      transform: "rotate(-90 14 " + (height / 2) + ")",
      "text-anchor": "middle"
    });
  }

  function renderUpdateCard() {
    const round = activeRound();
    const observation = document.createElement("div");
    observation.className = "gradient-boosting-observation";
    const observationTitle = document.createElement("strong");
    observationTitle.textContent = "Held-out observation ("
      + explorer.metadata.nFeatures + " features; observed NOx: "
      + explorer.predictionObservation.observedTarget.toFixed(2) + " mg/m³)";
    const tableContainer = document.createElement("div");
    tableContainer.className = "bagging-feature-table-wrap";
    tableContainer.append(makeFeatureTable());
    observation.append(observationTitle, tableContainer);

    const update = document.createElement("div");
    update.className = "gradient-boosting-score-update";
    const updateTitle = document.createElement("strong");
    updateTitle.textContent = "Stage " + round.stage + " prediction update";
    const equation = document.createElement("p");
    equation.className = "gradient-boosting-equation";
    equation.textContent = "ŷ ← ŷ + " + explorer.metadata.learningRate.toFixed(2)
      + " × (" + (round.fixedObservation.treeCorrection >= 0 ? "+" : "")
      + round.fixedObservation.treeCorrection.toFixed(2) + " mg/m³)";
    const metrics = document.createElement("div");
    metrics.className = "gradient-boosting-update-metrics";
    metrics.append(
      makeMetric("Prediction before", round.fixedObservation.predictionBefore.toFixed(2) + " mg/m³", "current model prediction"),
      makeMetric("Correction", (round.fixedObservation.predictionChange >= 0 ? "+" : "") + round.fixedObservation.predictionChange.toFixed(2) + " mg/m³", "learning rate × tree correction"),
      makeMetric("Prediction after", round.fixedObservation.predictionAfter.toFixed(2) + " mg/m³", "new model prediction"),
      makeMetric("Observed NOx", explorer.predictionObservation.observedTarget.toFixed(2) + " mg/m³", "shown only for comparison after prediction")
    );
    update.append(updateTitle, equation, metrics);
    updateCard.replaceChildren(observation, update);
  }

  function addChartLabel(svg, text, x, y, attributes = {}) {
    return addText(svg, text, x, y, Object.assign({
      class: "gradient-boosting-chart-label",
      "text-anchor": "middle"
    }, attributes));
  }

  function drawLineChart(svg, configuration) {
    const width = 720;
    const height = 315;
    const padding = { top: 20, right: 22, bottom: 47, left: 58 };
    const values = configuration.fullSeries.flatMap((series) => series.values);
    const rawMin = Math.min(...values);
    const rawMax = Math.max(...values);
    const span = Math.max(rawMax - rawMin, 0.03);
    const domain = [rawMin - 0.08 * span, rawMax + 0.08 * span];
    const x = (stage) => scale(stage, [0, nStages], [padding.left, width - padding.right]);
    const y = (value) => scale(value, domain, [height - padding.bottom, padding.top]);
    const visibleStages = Array.from({ length: includedStages + 1 }, (_, index) => index);

    svg.replaceChildren();
    svg.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 " + width + " " + height);
    svg.setAttribute("preserveAspectRatio", "xMidYMid meet");
    const title = svgElement("title", { id: svg.id + "-title" });
    const description = svgElement("desc", { id: svg.id + "-description" });
    title.textContent = configuration.title;
    description.textContent = configuration.description;
    svg.append(title, description);
    svg.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", title.id + " " + description.id);

    for (let index = 0; index <= 4; index += 1) {
      const value = domain[0] + (index / 4) * (domain[1] - domain[0]);
      const yPosition = y(value);
      svg.append(svgElement("line", {
        x1: padding.left,
        y1: yPosition,
        x2: width - padding.right,
        y2: yPosition,
        class: "gradient-boosting-chart-grid"
      }));
      addText(svg, value.toFixed(2), padding.left - 8, yPosition + 4, {
        class: "gradient-boosting-chart-tick",
        "text-anchor": "end"
      });
    }
    [0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60].forEach((stage) => {
      addText(svg, String(stage), x(stage), height - padding.bottom + 19, {
        class: "gradient-boosting-chart-tick",
        "text-anchor": "middle"
      });
    });
    svg.append(
      svgElement("line", { x1: padding.left, y1: padding.top, x2: padding.left, y2: height - padding.bottom, class: "gradient-boosting-chart-axis" }),
      svgElement("line", { x1: padding.left, y1: height - padding.bottom, x2: width - padding.right, y2: height - padding.bottom, class: "gradient-boosting-chart-axis" })
    );
    addChartLabel(svg, "Correction trees added", (padding.left + width - padding.right) / 2, height - 7);
    addText(svg, configuration.yLabel, 15, height / 2, {
      class: "gradient-boosting-chart-axis-title",
      transform: "rotate(-90 15 " + (height / 2) + ")",
      "text-anchor": "middle"
    });

    configuration.visibleSeries.forEach((series) => {
      const points = visibleStages.map((stage, index) => [x(stage), y(series.values[index])]);
      const path = points.map((point, index) => (index === 0 ? "M " : "L ") + point[0].toFixed(2) + " " + point[1].toFixed(2)).join(" ");
      svg.append(svgElement("path", { d: path, fill: "none", stroke: series.color, "stroke-width": 3 }));
      const finalPoint = points[points.length - 1];
      svg.append(svgElement("circle", { cx: finalPoint[0], cy: finalPoint[1], r: 4.6, fill: series.color, stroke: "#fff", "stroke-width": 1.6 }));
    });
    configuration.visibleSeries.forEach((series, index) => {
      const legendX = padding.left + index * 175;
      const legendY = 15;
      svg.append(svgElement("line", { x1: legendX, y1: legendY, x2: legendX + 25, y2: legendY, stroke: series.color, "stroke-width": 3 }));
      addText(svg, series.label, legendX + 32, legendY + 4, { class: "gradient-boosting-chart-value" });
    });
  }

  function renderCharts() {
    const allStages = explorer.rounds;
    const trainLoss = [explorer.baseline.trainMse, ...allStages.map((round) => round.trainMse)];
    const testLoss = [explorer.baseline.testMse, ...allStages.map((round) => round.testMse)];
    const testR2 = [explorer.baseline.testR2, ...allStages.map((round) => round.testR2)];
    drawLineChart(lossChart, {
      title: "Mean squared error",
      description: "Training and held-out mean squared error as gradient-boosting correction trees are added.",
      yLabel: "MSE",
      fullSeries: [{ values: trainLoss }, { values: testLoss }],
      visibleSeries: [
        { label: "Training", values: trainLoss, color: colors.train },
        { label: "Held-out", values: testLoss, color: colors.test }
      ]
    });
    drawLineChart(r2Chart, {
      title: "Held-out R²",
      description: "Held-out R-squared as gradient-boosting correction trees are added.",
      yLabel: "Held-out R²",
      fullSeries: [{ values: testR2 }],
      visibleSeries: [{ label: "Held-out R²", values: testR2, color: colors.boost }]
    });
  }

  function stopAnimation() {
    if (animationFrame !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
    animationFrame = null;
    isRunning = false;
    runButton.textContent = "Run all stages";
  }

  function render() {
    const atLastStage = includedStages === nStages;
    stageCountOutput.textContent = String(includedStages);
    nextButton.disabled = atLastStage;
    runButton.disabled = atLastStage;
    renderBaseline();
    renderTreeCard();
    renderUpdateCard();
    renderCharts();
  }

  function runAll(timestamp) {
    if (!isRunning) return;
    if (!lastFrameTime || timestamp - lastFrameTime >= 95) {
      lastFrameTime = timestamp;
      if (includedStages < nStages) {
        includedStages += 1;
        render();
      }
    }
    if (includedStages < nStages) {
      animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(runAll);
    } else {
      stopAnimation();
      render();
    }
  }

  nextButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    stopAnimation();
    if (includedStages < nStages) includedStages += 1;
    render();
  });
  runButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (isRunning) {
      stopAnimation();
      return;
    }
    isRunning = true;
    lastFrameTime = 0;
    runButton.textContent = "Pause";
    animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(runAll);
  });
  resetButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    stopAnimation();
    includedStages = 1;
    render();
  });

  render();
})();
</script>
```
